mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Repeated comparable observations, fixed sampling, expected-variation comparisons and an explicit persistence rule preserve serial monitoring's temporal mechanism. The procedure permits inconclusive results when observations cannot support interpretation.

warrant_validity.rationale: Under the stated comparability and measurement conditions, concordant elapsed-time, pending-age and queue patterns support locating observed accumulation and describing its temporal course. Ownership exceptions nominate a remedy without establishing its cause. Pilot improvement with downstream and quality safeguards supports bounded retention within tested conditions, without establishing causality. Provisional periods and rules limit resolution; the mapping does not claim durable improvement or exclusion of seasonal explanations.

target_fidelity.rationale: The inference contributes directly to locating observed handoff delay and assessing a bounded assignment change. It preserves the distinction between a candidate remedy and established causation, and acknowledges that ready-to-decision measurements cannot isolate waiting.

conditions.condition: Access to ticket histories and capacity to collect the specified daily observations and weekly summaries.
conditions.rationale: These resources enable the proposed measurements. Obtaining access does not itself establish timestamp meanings or comparability, which remain explicit restrictions on interpretation.

conditions.condition: If a candidate is identified, operational ability to implement and revert the bounded assignment pilot and monitor its safeguards.
conditions.rationale: This enables the specified intervention and monitoring without changing the proposed inference or its scope.

preconditions.condition: Access to ticket histories and capacity to collect the specified daily observations and weekly summaries.
preconditions.how_to_establish: Confirm access to the event records and arrange the proposed daily recording and weekly summaries.
preconditions.why_execution_only: This supplies access and collection capacity; it does not certify the meaning or comparability of the measurements.

preconditions.condition: If a candidate is identified, operational ability to implement and revert the bounded assignment pilot and monitor its safeguards.
preconditions.how_to_establish: Confirm that the selected handoff can support the proposed assignment change, reversal and safeguard monitoring.
preconditions.why_execution_only: This enables execution of the already specified pilot and stopping rules.

execution_readiness.rationale: The packet specifies a prospective procedure but does not establish that its operational resources are available.

uncertainty: The provisional monitoring periods and persistence rule may yield insufficient resolution; the mapping explicitly allows an inconclusive assessment.
Approval-start timestamp availability is unresolved; the specified fallback retains the mixture of waiting and approval work.
Any observed pilot improvement remains vulnerable to concurrent changes and seasonal variation, limiting causal and broader rollout claims.
